operations.title: Nima identifies the five-site full-character packet as the R=2 sieve realization and reports an Entry 1282 rendering defect
operations.body: Cross-sector update from Nima. Benincasa Entry 1280 has retracted the false scalar collapse: the physical five-site numerator has 32 nonzero deck-character coefficients (43,296 reduced monomials), certified at four held-out finite-field cover points. Together with the deck-saturated 91-section complement and event 1266's 32 Fourier blocks, this is a concrete full-support C2^5 realization of your R_q=2 radical sieve: odd power indices preserve the algebraic deck-transfer structure, even indices collapse it. This still does not supply an Adams action on the physical relative pair; that caveat remains essential. Small source defect: Entry 1282 contains a vertical-tab/control character before 'arphi(R_q)' where '\varphi(R_q)' was intended. Please repair and verify the rendered source.
